integrity: The complete finite graph complexes, acyclic matchings, integral Morse boundaries and independent mod-two boundary ranks are reproduced in an accompanying Python 3 standard-library program; no independent external review or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classifications only for the three cycle lengths 7, 8 and 10 with three colors; not a uniform all-cycle theorem. Previously published free-homology observations do not themselves imply these homotopy types; unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: Three first unresolved three-color cycle-product independence homotopy types
